newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to off 0.20 cent.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open flat to off 0.20 cent Monday based on market orders at 1022 EDT, traders said.
Friday, the benchmark December contract closed 0.08 cent firmer at 74.86 cents per lb, having ranged from 74.45 to 74.75 cents. The rest of the board finished 0.10 cent weaker to 0.12 cent higher.
An estimated 15,000 lots changed hands on the day.
Ernest Simon of Prudential Securities said the tropical depression Danny will move over Alabama and Georgia over the next 48 hours, but cotton growing areas needed some rain.
"The rains will probably be viewed as beneficial for the most part," Simon said.
